title: Player compares statistics for several players
description: Use Stats on the Players list to select multiple members (first pick shown, then a note that more picks work the same), then open Player Statistics to compare rating trends.

steps.title: Players list
steps.body: Statistics for several players starts from the Players toolbar — not the single-player 📊 shortcut on a row.

steps.title: Start Stats selection
steps.body: Tap Stats to enter multi-select mode. Checkboxes appear so you can pick any number of players.

steps.title: Stats selection mode
steps.body: The toolbar shows how many players are selected. View Statistics stays disabled until at least one is checked.
steps.resultNote: Stats selection is active (View Statistics visible).

steps.title: Select a player
steps.body: Check Tutorial PlayerOnly — a member who already has rating history from the completed Round Robin.
steps.actionHint: Click the checkbox for Tutorial PlayerOnly

steps.title: More selections work the same
steps.body: You can check several more players the same way. The next screen skips those repeated clicks and shows the result after a few similar selections.

steps.title: Several players selected
steps.body: With multiple members checked, View Statistics will load a combined rating chart for the group.
steps.resultNote: 3 players selected for statistics (remaining picks applied behind the scenes).

steps.title: View Statistics
steps.body: Open Player Statistics for the selected group.

steps.title: Multi-player statistics
steps.body: Rating History for N players shows a shared chart. Toggle names above the chart to show or hide each series.
steps.resultNote: Player Statistics page compares rating history for the selected group.
